scope: DECISIVE: the per-field unit is one present bit plus an optional delta record, and the table really is 0xDA63E8 with 24 entries
disassembly_0x471b9e: 0x471B9E mov edx,edi ; call 0x447190   -> read ONE bit (the per-field present flag)
0x471BA5 cmp eax,1 ; je 0x471BE7       -> present == 1: SKIP this field (no delta, no more bits)
0x471BC6..0x471BC8 push 3, push 0xDA63E8, push 0x18, ... ; call 0x670FF0  -> present == 0: decode a delta
0x471BF3..0x471C00 loop counter++, compare with [eax+0x3BA0], jl back
what_this_establishes: the per-field unit is [present(1 bit)] followed, only when present == 0, by one delta record
the delta decoder 0x670FF0 receives the table 0xDA63E8 and the count 0x18 = 24, so the 24-entry table at 0xDA63E8 is the correct one for this call
the loop iterates over the ps history slot count, not over delta records
why_rec2_failed: rec2 wrote continuation=1 immediately after the first delta, but that position is the NEXT field's PRESENT bit
present == 1 means 'field unchanged, skip', so the loop advanced and the rest of our bits were consumed as further present flags and deltas - hence one decode and then a stream error

corrected_encoder_shape.per_field: present(1); if 0 then ONE delta record (continuation(1), V(5), distance, value)
corrected_encoder_shape.terminator: the has-ps bit at the top of the next iteration is 0
corrected_encoder_shape.accepted_body_consistency: 8 prologue + 1 present(0) + [1 + 5 + 13 + 1] delta + 1 terminator = 29 bits - matches the accepted body exactly

next_test: encode TWO fields as present(0)+delta for field 0 and present(0)+delta for field 1, then the terminator
predict: the PsField probe records TWO decodes (indices 0 and 1) and the body stays accepted
if that holds, the encoder is a simple loop and multi-field encoding - and therefore origin - becomes possible
note_on_the_0xda8520_dump: the earlier 0xDA8520 dump (offset 0 / codec -97, then 264/-75, ...) does not fit table+12*index from 0xDA63E8 (8504 is not divisible by 12)

so 0xDA8520 is some other structure; the PsField probe's ECX at 0x6701D0 entry is therefore not simply table+12*index in that call path and should not be used to identify fields until that is understood
